Releases of clusterflick.com's published datasets, a month to a release.
One JSON row per release of `data-transformed` (`data`) or `data-calendar`
(`calendar`): `{ dataset, repository, tag, publishedAt }`. See
scripts/append-release-log.js. Read by clusterflick.com for its data status
page, https://clusterflick.com/datasets/status/

⚠️ **Internal telemetry — not licensed.** No rights are granted over it and the row shape changes without notice. For data you can use, see https://clusterflick.com/data-licence
